title: Coordinator, Groups Programs
description:
The Groups Programs Coordinator supports the administration and delivery of Charters, Incentives, Large Groups, and Travel Advisor Conference programs after the proposal cycle is complete. The role will create and maintain program bookings, coordinate pricing, liase with Revenue Management for group setup, process onboard credits and pre-cruise amenity orders, support servicing, reporting, payment management, assistance with charter loads ins and embarkation as needed, and post-charter reconciliation across the CMI portfolio. This position works closely with CMI Leadership, Sales Directors, Revenue Management, Finance, Reservations, Shipboard Teams, and other internal stakeholders to ensure program data, financial activity, documentation, and guest-facing arrangements are accurate, timely, and aligned with approved program requirements.

Essential Functions:

  • Group Booking Creation and Administration: Create and manage group program bookings after the proposal cycle is complete. Establish and maintain accurate booking records throughout the berthing process, program identifiers, inventory details, key dates, and supporting documentation; process approved updates and ensure information remains current throughout the servicing lifecycle.

  • Onboard Credits and Pre-Cruise Orders: Coordinate and apply onboard credits and manage Bon Voyage and Fun Shop orders for charter and large group programs. Validate approved amounts, guest or booking details, funding sources, deadlines, and supporting documentation; partner with the appropriate internal teams to resolve discrepancies and confirm accurate completion.

  • Portfolio Servicing, Reporting, and Payment Management: Support ongoing servicing across the CMI portfolio, including maintaining trackers, preparing group summaries and status reports, monitoring deadlines, coordinating payment activity, researching variances, and following up with internal stakeholders and external partners as directed.

  • Pricing Coordination and Group Setup: Coordination and group setup with Revenue Management for large groups and Travel Advisor conferences. Compile requirements, submit setup requests, track approvals and changes, validate that approved pricing and terms are reflected accurately, and escalate exceptions or unresolved issues to CMI leadership.

  • Post-Charter Reconciliation: Assist with post-charter reconciliation by gathering final program and financial data, supporting attrition calculations, coordinating partner invoicing, reconciling supporting records, tracking open items, and retaining documentation in accordance with established requirements.

  • Process Compliance and Continuous Improvement: Maintain organized and audit-ready program files, follow established controls and procedures, identify data or process gaps, and recommend practical improvements that increase accuracy, consistency, and efficiency.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:

  • Scope: Supports a portfolio of Charter, Large Group, and Travel Advisor Conference programs from post-proposal booking setup through servicing and post-charter closeout. The role manages detailed booking, pricing, payment, onboard credit, amenity order, reporting, invoicing, and document-retention activities across multiple concurrent programs. Works cross-functionally with CMI leadership, Sales, Revenue Management, Finance, Reservations, shipboard teams, and other operational partners. No direct reports.

  • Problem-solving: Researches and resolves routine booking, pricing, payment, onboard credit, order, and reconciliation discrepancies by reviewing source documentation and coordinating with the appropriate partners. Applies established procedures and sound judgment, maintains accurate records, and escalates exceptions, control concerns, or matters outside approved authority.

  • Impact: Accurate and timely execution supports the financial integrity, operational readiness, and service quality of CMI programs. Errors or delays may affect guest arrangements, partner billing, payment status, reporting accuracy, and program closeout; therefore, close attention to detail and proactive follow-up are essential.

  • Leadership: No direct reports. Demonstrates ownership of assigned activities, coordinates across multiple stakeholders, communicates status and risks clearly, and contributes to consistent team processes and service standards.

For all roles:

  • Knowledge: Understanding of workplace policies and procedures / Familiarity with team collaboration tools and techniques.

  • Skills: Strong time management and organizational skills

  • Abilities: Ability to maintain reliable and consistent attendance / Capacity to be punctual and meet deadlines / Ability to collaborate effectively with colleagues and work as part of a team / Demonstrated professionalism in all interactions and tasks.

Essential/Minimum qualifications:

  • High School GED and 2+ years demonstrated experience in similar role or responsibilities

Essential experience required:

  • Candidate should have experience in program coordination, sales administration, hospitality, events, or a related business environment. Experience managing bookings, payments, reporting, invoicing, and program documentation, while coordinating with cross-functional teams to deliver projects in a timely manner. Proficiency with business systems, Microsoft Office applications, and maintaining detailed records in a fast paced, deadline driven environment is required.

Travel: No or very little travel likely

Work Conditions: Work primarily in a climate-controlled environment with minimal safety/health hazard potential.

Physical Demands. Must be able to remain in a stationary position at a desk and/or computer for extended periods of time.

This position is classified as “in-office.” As an in-office role, it requires employees to work from a designated Carnival office in South Florida Monday through Thursday each week. Delivering bundles of joy has got to be one of the most important jobs in the world. Right? Of course, As a labor & delivery nurse, your empathy meter is off the charts. How could it not be? It’s babies for goodness' sake. You bring psychological and emotional support, monitor mom and her newborn, and ensure the best medical care and resources when the need arises. Having a baby is one of the most vulnerable times in the lives of moms and dads and you’ve got their backs.

Labor, birth, and postpartum never get routine for you. Bring on the bundles of cuteness and the memories. You’ll share tears of joy and, sometimes, tears of sadness. You’re extraordinary. That's what we love about you.

Your experiences, knowledge, skills, empathy, compassion, and your “little something extra” all add up to you. And we’re excited to get to know you and find out what you’ll bring to this hands-on nursing role.

Your Everyday

Take the lead: prioritizing, coordinating, and delegating all care touchpoints for your patient’s delivery and post-partum care.

Collaborate with team members to ensure appropriate mom/baby care.

Maintain and advocate a safe environment for everyone.

Monitor and engage with your patients, families, and appropriate care team members concerning significant events, patient condition changes, or patient questions and concerns.

Prevent and treat wounds.

Monitor and execute Joint Commission infection control and environment of care requirements.

Ensure continuity of care, efficient throughput, consistent communications, and an exceptional experience for every patient and their families.

Advise and consult with supervisor when unable to complete assignments or perform tasks promptly, effectively, or safely.

Initiate patient and family education using appropriate resources and continuum of care

description:
AVEVA System Platform Specialist
Location: Hampshire, UK
Type: Permanent | Full-Time

Package: Competitive salary + up to 7% matched pension, healthcare plan, Health Shield cashback scheme, death in service, EV car scheme, share scheme, 25 days' holiday, flexi-time, and company workwear.

About the Role

Actemium Automation Hampshire is seeking an experienced and trusted AVEVA System Platform Specialist to join our growing automation team. In this role, you will lead the delivery of SCADA, supervisory control and digital manufacturing solutions across the UK water sector, applying your specialist knowledge throughout the full project lifecycle from concept and design through to development, testing, commissioning and long-term support.

As part of VINCI Energies, you'll work alongside project managers, software engineers, and customers to deliver robust, scalable automation solutions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Act as a technical specialist for AVEVA System Platform, providing expertise throughout the full project lifecycle.

  • Design, develop and implement AVEVA System Platform and ArchestrA-based SCADA solutions for major water sector automation projects.

  • Develop and maintain robust object templates, graphics, alarms, security models, historians, and application server architectures.

  • Integrate AVEVA solutions with PLCs, HMIs, instrumentation, databases and industrial communication networks.

  • Produce high-quality functional design specifications, detailed design documentation and technical standards.

  • Lead system testing, Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT), Site Acceptance Testing (SAT), commissioning and ongoing technical support activities.

  • Diagnose complex system issues and provide effective technical solutions across operational and project environments.

  • Support engineering estimates, technical reviews, project planning activities and customer workshops.

  • Provide technical guidance and mentoring to engineers, promoting best practice and knowledge sharing across the business.

  • Ensure solutions comply with customer requirements, water industry standards, cybersecurity requirements and Actemium quality procedures.

About You

  • Proven experience delivering AVEVA System Platform, SCADA, DCS or industrial automation solutions within regulated industrial environments.

  • Extensive hands-on experience with AVEVA System Platform, ArchestrA and InTouch - OMI

  • Strong understanding of industrial control systems, including PLCs, HMIs, process control systems and industrial communications.

  • Demonstrable experience leading testing, commissioning, troubleshooting and support activities for complex automation systems.

  • Ability to interpret and develop functional specifications, control philosophies, P&IDs, electrical drawings and system architectures.

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving and customer-facing communication skills.

  • Recognised as a technical authority within your field, with the ability to influence technical decisions and drive best practice.

  • HNC/HND, Degree or equivalent experience in Engineering, Control Systems, Automation or a related discipline.

Desirable:

  • Experience within the UK water industry and knowledge of associated standards and practices.

  • Experience with SQL Server, scripting, industrial networking, virtualisation or OT cybersecurity.

  • AVEVA certifications or demonstrable expertise in AVEVA technologies.

  • Professional registration or membership of a relevant engineering institution.

Why Join Us?

  • Work on challenging automation and SCADA projects across diverse industries.

  • Join a collaborative and supportive engineering team.

  • Access ongoing technical and career development.

  • Progress within Actemium and the wider VINCI Energies group.

  • Be part of a culture focused on safety, quality, innovation, and inclusion.

Apply

If you're an experienced AVEVA or SCADA specialist looking for your next challenge, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Quality Assurance Lead
description:
Leaptel is a rapidly growing, Australian-owned internet service provider based in Melbourne. We’re passionate about delivering a fast, reliable internet experience for our customers, and we’re continuing to invest in the technology, systems and people that make that possible.

We’re looking for a Quality Assurance Lead to shape our QA function, strengthen our testing practices, and help our development and project teams deliver reliable, high-quality software and customer experiences.


The role

Reporting to the Development Manager, you’ll lead a QA team while staying hands-on. You’ll work closely with Developers, Project Managers, Product Owners, and business stakeholders to plan and oversee testing, manage quality risks, and continuously improve our QA approach across multiple projects.

What the role involves

  • Lead and develop the QA team - coach and support your team, build capability and ensure QA resources are effectively planned across concurrent projects.
  • Own our QA approach - establish and improve testing processes, standards, documentation and practices that support consistent, high-quality delivery.
  • Oversee testing and release readiness - coordinate manual, automated, integration, regression, and UAT, monitor defects and quality risks, and provide clear recommendations on release readiness.
  • Build a stronger automation capability - define and scale our test automation approach, identifying opportunities to improve efficiency, coverage and confidence in our releases.
  • Drive quality through collaboration and insight - work across technical and business teams, guide UAT, communicate testing outcomes and use QA metrics to identify opportunities for improvement.

What we’re looking for

You’re an experienced QA professional who enjoys combining technical expertise with people leadership. You bring structure without unnecessary process, can see the bigger picture, and are confident influencing both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Key experience

  • 5+ years in software QA, testing or a related discipline, including 2+ years leading, mentoring or coordinating a QA team or function.
  • Strong understanding of software testing methodologies, automation and defect management practices.
  • Hands-on capability across manual and automated testing, including test planning, regression, integration and UAT.
  • A track record of improving QA processes and practices within a growing organisation.
  • Comfortable working in Agile/Scrum environments and across multiple concurrent projects.
  • Proficiency with testing and project management tools such as Jira, Confluence, Monday.com or similar platforms.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Relevant qualifications in Information Technology, Software Testing, Project Management or a related field, or demonstrated equivalent practical experience.

Why you’ll love working at Leaptel

At Leaptel, our people come first. We value work-life balance, support each other, and want people to enjoy the work they do.

  • Hybrid working after probation
  • Employee internet discount
  • Comprehensive EAP support through Sonder
  • A collaborative team where you’ll have the opportunity to make a genuine impact
  • The chance to lead and shape a growing QA function

We’re committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and respected. We believe a range of backgrounds, skills and perspectives strengthens our work and drives innovation. We’re an equal opportunity employer and encourage applications from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples, women, people of colour, LGBTQI+ individuals, people with disabilities, and people from diverse ethnic and cultural backgrounds.

Ready to help shape quality at Leaptel?

If you’re excited by the opportunity to lead a QA team, improve how we test and help deliver reliable software and great customer experiences, we’d love to hear from you!

Apply now with your CV and cover letter, telling us why you’re interested in the role.

If you have any questions, don't hesitate to reach out to us at careers@team.leaptel.com.au
